newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - British ADRs strong in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - British ADRs strong in New York.

text.p: Strength in several British companies livened up a mixed ADR market, with British Airways Plc among the main beneficiaries.
British Airways shares were up two at 92 on the New York Stock Exchange on Friday morning as UK traders bought calls.
Call buying also pushed up British Petroleum which was up 2-1/2 at 131-1/2.
Dealers in London said said the buying was sparked by expectations of better times ahead in the economy.
Among today's losers Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd was down 2-3/4 at 167 on the NYSE.
